system.title: Parameter estimation of a whole-brain model with a hybrid physics-informed neural network (r07)

planets.label: Hybrid PINN estimation of MPR whole-brain parameters
planets.detail: Estimate the regional excitabilities eta_i and the global coupling G of an MPR whole-brain model with a hybrid physics-informed neural network.

evidence.quote: the regional excitabilities $\eta_i$ and the global coupling $G$ of a Montbrió–Pazó–Roxin (MPR) whole-brain model, estimated with a hybrid physics-informed neural network (PINN)

planets.label: Resting-state functional connectivity
planets.detail: The simulated BOLD, through a Balloon-Windkessel model, must reproduce the measured resting-state FC of one subject.

evidence.quote: reproduce the resting-state BOLD of a real subject

planets.label: Physics-informed neural networks
planets.detail: A network maps time to (r, V) of every region; the residuals of the MPR equations enter the loss.

evidence.quote: The derivatives come from automatic differentiation.

planets.label: Single-subject resting-state fMRI
planets.detail: Any instance with N regions, T volumes at TR, field B0 and echo time TE; version 1 uses one subject of 1000BRAINS v1.1.

evidence.quote: one subject of a resting-state dataset, parcellated into $N$ regions, with $T$ volumes at repetition time TR

planets.label: A good fit does not determine the parameters
planets.detail: A parameter set that reproduces the data is not enough if the data do not determine it.

evidence.quote: a parameter set that reproduces the data is not enough if the data do not determine it

planets.label: Interpretable eta_i and G from a hybrid PINN
planets.detail: The estimated eta_i and G reproduce the resting-state FC and are interpreted only if stable across seeds and loss weights and inside the bistable range.

evidence.quote: can be interpreted as properties of that brain

planets.label: Parameter inference for brain network models
planets.detail: Estimation of the parameters of a connectome-based model from neuroimaging data.

evidence.quote: Only $\eta_i$ and $G$ are estimated; every other parameter is fixed and declared.

planets.label: Hybrid PINN with a differentiable hemodynamic forward model
planets.detail: Network weights, eta_i and G trained jointly; the network output feeds a differentiable RK4 Balloon-Windkessel integration so the BOLD FC is compared with the data.

evidence.quote: The network output feeds a differentiable RK4 integration of the Balloon–Windkessel model, so that the BOLD and its FC can be compared with the data.

planets.label: Identifiability and interpretability criteria
planets.detail: Parameters are interpreted only when repeated training from different seeds and initial values converges, they are stable over the grid of loss weights, and eta_i lie in the bistable range (-5.35, -2.45).

evidence.quote: The parameters are called interpretable when two conditions hold.

planets.label: Physics residual scales for hidden states
planets.detail: Equations non-dimensionalised; each residual divided by a fixed scale derived from the magnitude of the terms of its equation, since r and V are not observed.

evidence.quote: each residual is divided by the sum of the absolute values of the terms of its equation

planets.label: FC correlation read against noise ceilings
planets.detail: Expected, not yet measured: rho_FC read against the seed ceiling and, when the instance has a second session, the session ceiling.

evidence.quote: Success is measured by $\rho_{\mathrm{FC}}$ against the ceilings of Section 6

planets.label: Parameters interpreted only if identifiable
planets.detail: Expected, not yet measured: if runs reach different parameters with the same FC, the parameters are not interpreted.

evidence.quote: If runs reach different values with the same FC, the parameters are not identifiable and they are not interpreted.

pillars.label: Existence
pillars.detail: Parameters obtained with the PINN, integrated forward through the hemodynamic model, yield an FC that matches the real FC.

pillars.label: Identifiability
pillars.detail: The data determine the parameters; otherwise they are not interpreted.

pillars.label: Balanced physics loss
pillars.detail: The physics term is non-dimensionalised and scaled by fixed constants so that no term dominates by units alone.

hypotheses.statement: There exist eta_i and G, obtained with the PINN, such that integrating the MPR model forward with them and passing the result through the Balloon-Windkessel model and the BOLD equation yields a functional connectivity (FC) that matches the real FC.
The data determine the parameters: repeated training with different seeds and different initial values of eta_i and G converges to the same values.
With synthetic data generated from known eta_i and G chosen away from the centre of the prior, the method recovers them.
